payload.title: LERM applied to ODP cores
payload.description: This notebook applies the Local Embedding Reconstruction Method (LERM) to Ocean Drilling Program (ODP) cores to recreate Figure 2 from a publication focused on the Mid-Pleistocene-Transition (MPT).

steps.description: Import necessary scientific computing libraries and suppress warnings for presentation purposes.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Suppress Warnings

steps.description: Define group lists for easy loading of ODP core data.
steps.title: Define Group Lists for Data Loading

dependencies: Define Group Lists for Data Loading
steps.description: Load time series data from the LR04 stack and process it to exclude discontinuities, particularly in ODP core 927 around 4000 ka.
steps.title: Load and Process Time Series Data

dependencies: Load and Process Time Series Data
steps.description: Set parameters for the Local Embedding Reconstruction Method, including embedding dimension and tau, which is selected according to the first minimum of mutual information.
steps.title: Set LERM Parameters

steps.description: Apply the Local Embedding Reconstruction Method to the processed data and visualize the results to recreate Figure 2 from the original publication.
steps.title: Apply LERM and Visualize Results
